Submittable Filter

A free Chrome extension for writers to filter spam and irrelevant listings from Submittable's Discover page.

Add to Chrome — Free

One click to install. Runs automatically on Submittable Discover.

What it does

Detects spam

Auto-identifies publications and counts their listings. The worst offenders float to the top.

One-click blocking

Block individual publications or bulk-block everything with 3+ or 5+ listings at once.

Flags new listings

Green "NEW" badges on listings since your last visit. Quickly spot what's fresh.

Keyword filtering

Hide entire genres and submission types with toggles. Screenwriting, grants, contests — gone.

Saves automatically

Block lists persist between visits. No account needed.

Shareable

Export your block list and share it with other writers. They import it in one click.

How to use

After installing, go to Submittable Discover and scroll through listings. The extension auto-collects publication names and counts as you scroll. A clay-colored circle button appears at the bottom right of the page. Tap it to open the filter panel, and check the Frequency tab to see which publications are flooding the feed. Block the worst ones individually or use the bulk buttons. Everything saves automatically.
